identity_rule: Keep existing source and derivative IDs. Workspaces, modes, titles, and filenames do not mint new asset identities.

modes.name: Quick Picks
modes.purpose: Collect, compare, and select existing visuals.

modes.name: Photography
modes.purpose: Review captured photographs and their edits; capture origin must be declared.

modes.name: Podcasts
modes.purpose: Work with episodes, segments, and transcripts; an audio extension does not establish an episode.

format_support: File custody and byte verification only. Extension evidence does not verify file type, decoding, safety, origin, or artistic merit.

services.name: Verify
services.effect: Read a ZIP and report internal consistency.

services.name: Inspect care
services.effect: Read a verified kit and care record; emit findings and optionally a local report.

services.name: Craft review
services.effect: A person judges intent, form, fidelity, accessibility, and usefulness; evidence is recorded separately.

services.name: Create, edit, and render
services.effect: No editor or rendering provider is implemented by this kit.

services.name: Transcribe and caption
services.effect: Companions can be linked and inspected; generation and synchronization checks are not implemented.

services.name: Catalog and schedule care
services.effect: No persistent index, background monitor, or automatic maintenance is implemented.

services.name: Publish and deliver
services.effect: No delivery integration or publishing authority is implemented.
